title: The Echo That Came Back
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter II begins. Episode 1: The Echo That Came Back. The whole scale was home; the world had a song. And every night the Keeper sang it to the horizon. Tonight the horizon sang it back — with one note fallen. He asks the dark who it is, and the dark answers the only way it can: with a rest. An Elder keeper comes, listens, and names the wound — the song is broken. One sound had changed, and with it, everything. So the two set out toward the horizon to find where the fallen note had gone... and behind them, something was listening back. CHAPTER II — THE LISTENING DARK.  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #storytelling
